content: Job balu wulan, milka-bujarmanya, yamba nyulu yalaman, “Ngayu binal Godunku jiringa, nyulu ngaykunku wawu, nganya ngulkurrduku kujin-kujil. Ngayu binal ngayu juma God nyajilkuda. Ngayu juma nyungun nyajil ngaykuwunduku miyildaku, nyulu ngarrbal kari.” Jakalbaku Job bulmbuyman, yamba God nyungunji balkawan. Yinyamun Job nyuluku buban-bungajin, kari bulmbuyman baja Godundumunbu miyilbaku. Yinyaynka Godungku Job wawurr-wawurr-bungan, nyungundu kangkal-kangkal yindu-yindu dajin baja, dingkar-dingkar 7-bala, jalbu-jalbu kulur. Godungku Jobumu yalarrku junjuy-junjuy jirray dajin baja.
